description: Run ON24 webinars from your workflows: create and copy webinars, register people, and read registrants, attendees, poll and survey results and leads, starting workflows when someone registers or attends.

on24_new_attendee_any_event_trigger.description: Runs for each person who attends any of your ON24 events, live or on demand. People who attended before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It reads up to 1,000 attendances a day. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.attendee: The whole attendance as ON24 gives it, with questions, polls and surveys.
output.email: Their email address, for 'Get attendee by email'.
output.engagement_score: ON24's engagement score for them at this event.
output.first_archive_activity: When they first watched on demand, if they did.
output.first_live_activity: When they first joined live, if they did.

on24_new_attendee_trigger.description: Runs for each person who attends the event you choose in ON24, live or on demand. People who attended before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.attendee: The whole attendance as ON24 gives it, with questions, polls and surveys.
output.email: Their email address, for 'Get attendee by email'.
output.engagement_score: ON24's engagement score for them at this event.
output.first_archive_activity: When they first watched on demand, if they did.
output.first_live_activity: When they first joined live, if they did.

parameters.description: The event to watch.
parameters.name: event_id

output.email: Their email address, for 'Get registrant by email'.
output.partner_ref: The partner reference they came in with.
output.registrant: The whole registration as ON24 gives it.

on24_new_registrant_trigger.description: Runs for each person who registers for the event you choose in ON24. People registered before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
